About

apnea_fyi

A static site built with Jekyll.

Versions

Tool Version
Ruby 4.0.9
Jekyll 4.4.1
Bundler 4.0.24
jekyll-sass-converter 3.1.0 (uses Dart Sass via sass-embedded)

The exact gem versions are locked in Gemfile.lock. Commit that file so everyone gets the same versions.

Prerequisites (macOS)

1. Xcode command line tools

xcode-select --install

2. Homebrew

Install from brew.sh if you don’t have it.

3. Ruby 4.0.9 via chruby

Don’t use the Ruby that ships with macOS (2.6.x). It’s too old for this project.

brew install chruby ruby-install
ruby-install ruby 4.0.9

Add chruby to your shell config:

echo "source $(brew --prefix)/opt/chruby/share/chruby/chruby.sh" >> ~/.zshrc
echo "source $(brew --prefix)/opt/chruby/share/chruby/auto.sh" >> ~/.zshrc

Quit and reopen Terminal, then switch to the installed version:

chruby ruby-4.0.9
ruby -v    # should print ruby 4.0.9

To select it automatically in this project, create a .ruby-version file. With auto.sh loaded, chruby switches whenever you cd into the folder:

echo "4.0.9" > .ruby-version

Setup

git clone <repo-url> apnea_fyi    # skip if you already have the folder
cd apnea_fyi
gem install bundler
bundle install

bundle install reads the Gemfile and installs Jekyll and all plugins and themes.

Run the site locally

bundle exec jekyll serve --livereload

Open http://localhost:4000/. With --livereload, the browser refreshes when you save a file.

Always run Jekyll with bundle exec so it uses the gem versions from Gemfile.lock.

Useful commands

Command What it does
bundle exec jekyll serve Build and serve the site, rebuilding on changes
bundle exec jekyll serve --drafts Include posts in _drafts/
bundle exec jekyll build Build once into _site/ without serving
bundle exec jekyll doctor Check the site for config problems and deprecations
bundle update Update gems within the limits set in the Gemfile

Troubleshooting

ruby -v shows 2.6.x The shell is still using the macOS system Ruby. Check that the two chruby lines are in ~/.zshrc, reload with source ~/.zshrc, then run chruby ruby-4.0.9. Run chruby with no arguments to list installed Rubies. The active one is marked with *.

cannot load such file -- csv (or base64, bigdecimal, logger) This comes from running a Jekyll version older than 4.4 on Ruby 3.4 or newer. Jekyll 4.4 and later install csv and base64 as dependencies. Confirm the Gemfile has gem "jekyll", "~> 4.4" and run bundle update jekyll.

cannot load such file -- webrick Newer Ruby versions don’t bundle it. Run:

bundle add webrick

Sass error such as expected end of rule pointing at assets/css/index.sass Dart Sass looks for imports next to the stylesheet before checking _sass/. If the main stylesheet shares a name with an imported partial (for example assets/css/index.sass containing @import index), the file ends up importing itself. Rename either the stylesheet or the partial so the names differ. If you rename the stylesheet, update the <link> that references the compiled .css file in your layouts or includes.

@import is deprecated warnings These are harmless for now. Dart Sass plans to remove @import, so you may want to migrate to @use at some point.

Gem install fails with native extension errors Make sure the Xcode command line tools are installed (xcode-select --install).

Stale or odd output after config or dependency changes Stop the server, delete the generated folder, and start again:

rm -rf _site .jekyll-cache
bundle exec jekyll serve --livereload

Project notes

  • _config.yml isn’t reloaded by the live server. Restart jekyll serve after editing it.
  • _site/ and .jekyll-cache/ are generated and should be listed in .gitignore.
